section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1969
title: 18 ## Means Adopted for Committing Suicides Table 8 presents the statistics of suicidal deaths classified by the important means adopted. The majority took to drowning, poisons and hanging as the means of ending their lives and these were responsible for 21.3%, 21.3% and 17.8% of cases respectively.
